A. Background:
Terms of Refercnce for Procurement Associates in GMC
Guwahati Municipal Corporation being the ULB in Guwahati City, implements projects and
assignments pertaining to thesectors of Health, Sanitation, Urban Infrastructures, Waste Management,
Finance and allicd sectors entrusted by the provisions of relevant Act. Applicants are requested to
browse in to gmc.assam.gov.in for further details.
Guwahati Municipal Corporation intends to hire Procurement Associates to support the existing
procurenent mechanism and Procurement Officer of Guwahati Municipal Corporation to assist to
Procurement Processes that inludes Procurement of Goods, Works and Services.
B. Scope ofthe Services:
The two Procurement Associates willcarry out the following main activities, as support to the Procurement
Officer, as needed:
() Assist n preparing and updating periodically the project procurement plans and use of the relevant
Procurenment tools for the procurement activities;
(1) AssIst in Preparing/updating project procurement plans and strategies taking into account
the nature of the procurement activity, capacity of the procuring entities, prevailing market
conditions, activity level risks etc. The Procurement plan document will spell out the
detailed procurement arrangements (e.g., procurement strategy, method. bid evaluation
methodology of the major packages, timeline for the procurenment activities, contracting
arrangement etc.) for the Project including the risk mitigation measures.
(ii)Assist in Preparing the drafts of Invitation for Bids (IFB), Request for Expressions of
Interest (REO), Amendments. Bidding Document, Prequalification Document. and
Request for Proposals (RFP) following the Standard Procurenent Documents/Model
Procurement Docunents and prevailing standards;
(iv) Assist in bid opening and evaluation of bids, applications for prequalification, Expressions
of Interest, Technical Proposals. and Financial Proposals received from business entities
competing for contracts:
(v) Assist the relevant Branch OfficeIs & Procurement Oficer and in conducting negotiations with
awardee(s) of contracts;
(vi) Assist in drawing up draft negotiated contracts:
(vi) Provide hands on support to the relevant branches for effective contract management.
handholding of branch assistants/Office Assistants/TO/JTOs during procurement initiation phase
and also contract implementation phase:
(viii) Assist in maintaining records and other documentations required for procurement audit and
progress reporting purposes:
(x)
(ix)Assist in preparing monthly progress reports of procurement activities as required and directed by
Procurement Officer.
Any other relevant activity assigned by the Commissioner, GMC from time to time.
C. Required Qualifications and Experiecne:
(i) A first-class B.E/B,Tech in Civil Engineering with basic MO0C Certification in Public
Procurement issued by Finance Department, Government of ASsam.
(ii) Experience:
A minimum ofTwo (2)years of experience in public procurement for and/or on behalfof Government
of Assam. Must have adequate experience in handling e-procurement systems and GeM.
Experience Preferences:
Applicants with experience in EAP procurements shall have an added advantage.
D. No. of Posts:
There willbe two posts of Procurement Associate.
E. Reporting Requircments:
The Officer will report to the Procurement Officer, GMC. The incumbentwill submit monthly
report on significant procurement activities and issues. The work and performance of the Officer
shall be reviewed by the Comissioner, GMC on aperiodic basis.
F. Tenure/ Duration:
The contract with the incumbent would be signed initially for a period of cleven months and
renewed based on his/her performance.
G. Procurement Associate's Responsibility
The Procurement Associate shall be fully responsible to manage his day to day works with the
Procurenment Officer and Project team with high dedication, integrity and ethical behavior. The
Procurement Associate should not have any conflict of interest while working in the
procurement activities and should have integrity and keep all the project information
confidential.
H. Travel Requirements:
The incumbent shall be based full time at the designated and notified GMC office in Guwahati
and must be willing to travel to other offices and different project sites as and when necessary.
I. Facilities to be Provided by GMC:
GMC will provide the following facilities and services:
Office space including basic furniture and utilities.
Access to all reports, studies, data, photographs, maps, and institutions relating to the
works, access to all sites for surveys and investigations.
Counterpart staff to work with.
J. Age:
The Candidate should not be above 32years as on 01/01/2025.
K. Remuneration:
Rs 30000/-to Rs 45000/-per month (inclusive of local taxes) and will be fixed during negotiations.
